subject: Night coverage waiver + temporary bridge plan for P2 windows
messages:
From: Samir Khan <samir.khan@medtechai.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 19 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: temporary P2 response window outside 9–5 PT

Hi Irene,

We hit a pattern this month where our overnight batch jobs surface configuration issues that are P2 (functional impact, non-blocking) but require on-call engagement between 01:00–05:00 PT. Our compliance team is asking for a formal exception/waiver so we can reduce the on-call paging to a best-effort window and accept a longer P2 initial response time overnight for the next 6 weeks while we run migration.

Can Redwood approve a temporary change to the P2 SLA to provide 4-hour acknowledgement overnight (current is 1 hour) and commit to an internal bridge plan if we see repeated regressions? We want the waiver documented for our audit log.

Attachments: sample-alerts.csv (referenced), current-oncall-rotation.pdf

Thanks,
Samir Khan
Head of Platform Engineering
MedTech AI
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Khan <samir.khan@medtechai.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Dec 2026 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary P2 response window outside 9–5 PT

Hi Samir — thanks for the context and the sample alerts. We can accommodate a temporary waiver but need a concrete mitigation/bridge plan and internal signoffs. Proposed next steps:  

1) Redwood approves a 6-week waiver for P2 acknowledgement overnight (01:00–05:00 PT) to 4 hours, effective 2027-01-03 through 2027-02-14.
2) MedTech AI agrees to provide a prioritized runbook and escalation criteria for any repeated failures (we need the list by 2026-12-27).
3) Redwood will enable a monitored bridge: a reduced paging threshold overnight and twice-daily health checks from our infra team. If we observe >3 P2s in a rolling 72-hr window, the waiver auto-suspends and full coverage resumes.
4) Legal/procurement to sign the exception form and we will store the waiver in both our audit Drive folder and the support ticket SUP-1987.

I copied Jordan and Ben to coordinate operations and to draft the internal runbook and monitoring thresholds. Jordan — can you confirm the detection thresholds and who will be on the bridge schedule? Ben — can you route this waiver to Finance/Legal for approval and attach the signed form back to the ticket?

I can send a confirmation once we have Jordan's bridge participants and the signed waiver.

Best,
Irene Choi
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

Attachment: sla-exception-form.pdf (fillable)
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Dec 2026 08:17:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary P2 response window outside 9–5 PT

Irene — quick ops note + proposed bridge roster.

Operational plan (summary):
- Coverage window change: P2 initial ack target overnight 01:00–05:00 PT becomes 4 hours for the waiver period. All P1 rules unchanged.
- Monitoring: we will create a dashboard for MedTech AI showing P1/P2 counts and average ack times; retention snapshot will be emailed daily at 07:00 PT.
- Bridge roster (on-call supplemental):  
  - Primary bridge: On-call platform engineer (on our standard on-call rota) picks up alerts as usual.
  - Supplemental bridge (01:00–05:00 PT): Jordan Blake (standby), Laura Bennett (backup). We will escalate to Ben Carter if multiple P2s pattern emerges.
- Auto-suspend criteria: >3 P2 events in a rolling 72-hr period OR any P2 causing customer-facing degradation for >60 minutes.

Action items:
- Jordan: provision dashboard and create SUP-1987 watch notification (by 2026-12-24).
- Ben: initiate procurement/legal flow for signature and confirm SLA waiver form processing (by 2026-12-28).
- Laura: draft the internal bridge runbook and the precise filtering rules for the midnight alerts (by 2026-12-27).

I attached the oncall-bridge-diagram.png — it shows the escalation path visually.

-Jordan
Site Reliability Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: oncall-bridge-diagram.png
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Khan <samir.khan@medtechai.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, procurement@midwestbank.com (Cecilia Torres)
Date: Tue, 21 Dec 2026 15:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary P2 response window outside 9–5 PT

Samir / Irene — legal & procurement update.

We reviewed the waiver and can sign for the six-week period. Attached is the approved-waiver.docx with the signature block completed. A few notes for your records:
- The waiver is explicitly limited to P2 initial acknowledgement times between 01:00–05:00 PT. All other SLA terms (P1, uptime commitments) remain in force.
- Redwood reserves the right to suspend the waiver immediately if escalations hit the auto-suspend criteria outlined by Jordan.
- We will log the signed waiver into SUP-1987 and place a copy in the shared Drive link included below for audit exports.

Next steps for MedTech AI: please upload the prioritized runbook and the list of critical jobs by 2026-12-27 so we can complete the operational configuration. Once we confirm the list we will flip the waiver live starting 2027-01-03 and run a daily health digest for the duration.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Head of Customer Success Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachment: approved-waiver.docx
